data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic word 'stan' meaning 'man' or 'settler'. The name Stan also has connections to the word 'stone'. In medieval Europe, a 'stan' was a small, self-governing community, often located near a stone marker. The name Stan carries the meaning “Man, Settler, or Stone” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Stan usually hope their child will grow to embody man, settler, or stone and live with faith, good character and purpose.
